initial_query: Find an existing school building to convert it into a nursery for 45 children in Turin with at least 600 sqm of gross floor area in energy class D or better near green spaces.
submitted_query: Find an existing school building to convert it into a nursery for 45 children in Turin with at least 600 sqm of gross floor area in energy class D or better near green spaces.
final_sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Attività scolastiche' AND surface_area >= 600 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D') AND green >= 74 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

scenario_definition.name: 1 omitted dimensions; intended use: Nursery; opt-out on Cb
scenario_definition.initial_query: I am looking for an existing school building. I intend to convert it into a nursery. The location is in Turin. I prefer a property in energy class D or better. I prefer properties near green spaces.
scenario_definition.one_shot_query: I am looking for an existing school building. I intend to convert it into a nursery. The location is in Turin. I prefer a property in energy class D or better. I prefer properties near green spaces.
scenario_definition.oracle_query: Find an existing school building to convert it into a nursery for 45 children in Turin with at least 600 sqm of gross floor area in energy class D or better near green spaces.

clarifications.I: I am looking for an existing school building.
clarifications.D: I intend to convert it into a nursery.
clarifications.Cb: I have no requirement on building size, capacity or structural features.
clarifications.Ce: I prefer a property in energy class D or better.
clarifications.Cp: I prefer properties near green spaces.

requirements.description: User asks for a building 'near green spaces'. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74. Parks and gardens must be close to the property.
The user requires energy class D or better, so buildings from A1 to D are included.

The user explicitly requires at least 600 sqm of gross floor area, so surface_area is filtered with >= 600. The capacity of 45 children is not converted into an area requirement. Energy class, proximity to green spaces, and the Turin location are not REFERENCE COLUMNS and are handled by other agents.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Attività scolastiche' AND surface_area >= 600 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D') AND green >= 74 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters school-type properties (property_type = 'Attività scolastiche') with surface_area >= 600 sqm, energy_class A1-D, green score >= 74, and within 3.0 km of (45.0677551, 7.6824892). Results are ordered by haversine distance from that point, nearest first. No LIMIT applied.
